title: IN THE NIGHT WATCHES
FIND PEACE AT SUNRISE
end: The Morning Altar — begin every sunrise in prayer

scenes.a: The thoughts that kept you awake still linger.
In the dark hours before sunrise, you lie awake turning over every care.
God's Word reminds us of a quiet place to anchor our heart.
When I remember thee upon my bed, and meditate on thee in the night watches.
Lord, when the hours feel heavy, turn my restless mind toward your faithful goodness.
Fill the silent watches of my soul with your peace and steady grace.
Teach me to rest in your enduring love before this new day begins.
